title: Resolve chase progression conflict without allowing earlier reminders
public_pr_body:
The conflicting test asked for a firm reminder after the final reminder had been sent. The implementation already correctly blocks backward progression. Preserve the valid most-advanced-unsent case and explicitly assert that neither 7-day nor 14-day reminders can follow the 30-day reminder.

Validation: full unit suite, 5,078 tests across 376 files, passed. No application behavior or tests were weakened. Prefer #191 with the recovery fix over #186; this patch documents the resolution for #186.


Targets `claude/chase-steps`, the same base as #186.
